results.note: Ukrinform (2026-11-10 11:29 Kyiv) quotes Umerov on Telegram: 'We have moved to the trilateral Ukraine-US-Russia format' in Abu Dhabi on 10 Nov; Kyiv Independent reports Ukraine, Russia and the US concluded the first day of trilateral talks, which adjourned to 11 Nov.
The Air Force's morning summary (Ukrinform, 2026-11-10 08:27 Kyiv) counts from 18:00 on 9 Nov: one Iskander-M and 162 Shahed-type, Gerbera and Parodiya drones, 135 downed by 07:30 — below 165.

gCaptain (2026-11-10): UKMTO Warning 201-26 reports a tanker struck by an unidentified projectile about 19 nm NE of Lima, Oman, near the Strait of Hormuz, at 13:38 UTC (17:38 GST) on 10 Nov; Arab News also reported it.

No on-record White House/Pentagon/CENTCOM confirmation of a US strike on Iranian territory on 10 Nov was found: the CTP-ISW Iran Update for 10 Nov (data cutoff 14:00 ET = 22:30 Tehran) records no US strike, Middle East Eye (20:25 UTC) and Reuters report Rubio/US saying no new attacks are needed, and Google News searches show only the 2-7 Nov Qeshm strikes.

BLS CPI release for October 2026 (embargoed to 8:30 ET Tue 10 Nov, USDL-26-1685): 'The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in October' seasonally adjusted (headline CPI-U +0.4%).
BLS release of 10 Nov 2026 (8:30 ET) puts the SA one-month change in CPI-U less food and energy for October 2026 at 0.3%, meeting the 0.3%-or-more threshold.

Finance Ministry page updated 10 Nov 2026 14:00 (cap set by MF notice at 14:00 on 10 Nov, valid 11 Nov 00:00-24:00): maximum diesel price 46,40 Kč incl. VAT per litre (petrol 40,94); the Cenový věstník PDF itself was not reachable, figure taken from the ministry's own announcement page.

Infineon's own results release (EQS-News 10 Nov 2026 07:30 CET; also infineon.com PDF infpr202611-025) reports FY2026 revenue of EUR 16.353bn and forecasts FY2027 revenue of about EUR 20bn (headline: growth of more than 20 percent), i.e. ~1.22x FY2026, above the 15% threshold.

The clerk floor summary did not render, so this rests on outlets: The National News Desk (9 Nov, 12:27 ET) reports that Massie filed a privileged resolution with eight impeachment articles against Hegseth on Monday 9 Nov and read it on the House floor, and NPR/OPB (10 Nov) confirms he reintroduced it that Monday.

The clerk votes page did not render, so this rests on outlets: NPR/OPB (published 10 Nov, 20:21 ET) reports Tuesday's 211-204 House vote to refer Massie's Hegseth impeachment articles to committee, and Stars and Stripes, Time and ABC also report the 10 Nov vote.

The Jerusalem Post (10 Nov, updated 21:27 UTC) reports that Yashar submitted more than 61 MK signatures to Speaker Ohana on Tuesday 10 Nov demanding a vote to elect a new speaker, and Ohana then set the vote for next week; Arutz Sheva (10 Nov 16:03) and The Media Line (67 signatures) agree.
The Jerusalem Post (10 Nov) reports that after receiving the signatures Ohana scheduled the plenum vote to replace the speaker for next Tuesday, so no speaker other than Ohana was elected on 10 Nov.

The joint session took place at the Slovak National Gallery in Bratislava on 10 Nov (vlada.gov.sk release of 10.11.2026), but neither that release nor the full ČT24 (updated 10 Nov 20:30) or ČTK (10 Nov) reports mention any memorandum, agreement or protocol signed; ČT24 cites only the memorandum from the March meeting.
ČTK (10 Nov) reports that the student protest took place on náměstí Republiky; its own reporters estimated 'vyšší stovky', but it quotes the organisers' figure of 4,000 participants.

On 10 Nov only STAN's assembly club voted for a STAN-Spolu-Praha sobě coalition (announced by a STAN spokesperson to ČTK, with details due Wednesday); ČTK reports the joint announcement of the coalition by the leaders of STAN, Spolu and Praha sobě on 11 Nov.

The G7 ministers adopted a joint declaration at the 9-10 Nov Paris meeting, but it was first published on 11 Nov (gov.uk 11 Nov 12:42 UTC; Auswärtiges Amt and Farnesina also dated 11 Nov), and Jiji reported it unreleased as of late Tuesday night; diplomatie.gouv.fr showed no joint text dated 10 Nov.

Última Hora (11 Nov 23:27), citing BCP data, reports that on Tuesday 10 Nov payments reached 59,825 people, including blocked accounts for the portion not covered by the block, and AFD-linked clients (bcp.gov.py refused scripted reading).
